name: Shrewsbury Cake
desc: Not a cake but a crisp, buttery biscuit with a hint of lemon and a crinkled edge, baked in Shrewsbury since at least the 1500s. Restores 45 HP.

name: Fidget Pie
desc: Shropshire's harvest pie of gammon, apples and onion, once baked for the folk bringing in the corn. Restores 90 HP.

name: Darwin's Hand Lens
desc: A brass pocket lens of the kind Charles Darwin carried for looking at beetles, barnacles and everything else. The label in the case says it was his. The label may be optimistic.
msg: {name} sized it up through Darwin's Hand Lens!

name: Coalbrookdale Ingot
desc: A little bar of grey pig iron, cast at Darby's Old Furnace in Coalbrookdale, where iron was first smelted with coke in 1709. Still faintly warm, somehow.

name: Wenlock Medal
desc: A medal from the Wenlock Olympian Games, first held in Much Wenlock in 1850, which helped inspire the modern Olympics. Citius, altius, fortius.
effect_text: Speed up a stage the first time it comes out.
msg: {name} is off like a Wenlock sprinter!

name: Stiperstones Quartzite
desc: Pale, glittering quartzite from the Stiperstones ridge, about 480 million years old and shattered off the tors by Ice Age frost. Craftsfolk prize it; the Devil, reportedly, wants it back.
